addon:addon.name: Bosch Smart Home Camera Binding
addon:addon.description: This is the binding for the Bosch Smart Home Cameras of the second generation (Eyes Outdoor Camera II, Eyes Indoor Camera II). It talks to the cameras through their local API, an optional account adds what only the Bosch cloud can do.

parameter.name: snapshotAllowedNetworks
parameter.label: Snapshot Networks
parameter.description: Networks that may fetch the snapshot URLs, as comma separated CIDR blocks. Defaults to loopback and the private ranges, so images stay in the local network even if a link leaks.

parameter.name: rtspPort
parameter.label: RTSP Port
parameter.description: Port openHAB offers the streams of all cameras on, as plain RTSP without password. Each camera has its own address there, with its token in it. Leave empty or 0 to offer none.
